text:
marco: heads up — support got a production escalation from a fintech customer. They started seeing 401s and a huge retry loop after the client libs we regenerated rolled out earlier today. latency and billing spike reported.

support-eng: customer reported both Python and TS clients hitting the issue. Go less affected.

tina: what changed in the regen? OpenAPI diff / auth headers?

marco: looks like a subtle header ordering change in the new client stubs. our legacy signing middleware expects the same canonical ordering; the regen moved X-Request-ID before Authorization in the emitted requests. backend rejects -> 401 -> client retries.

lin: quick repro I ran locally: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Request-ID: 123" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```
If the header order flips we hit our old signing check.

tina: header order should be irrelevant. but existing signing code is brittle. Can we add a compatibility shim in the server to accept either order while we patch clients?

raj: opened an emergency PR to add a shim + regen with an explicit note: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1423 — also adding changelog entry (we missed documenting header-order change). tagging @tina for review.

devex-bot: build started for pr-1423 - CI triggered (unit + regen tests).

lin: immediate mitigation: pin SDK to `1.42.0` (pre-regen) for affected customers. I also added a short env flag in the SDK `REDWOOD_CLIENT_LEGACY_HEADER_ORDER=true` that restores the old emission order — can be used as hotfix in internal deployments.

marco: we should also audit retry behavior. The TS client currently ignores `Retry-After` on 401 and spins exponential retries which amplifies billing. need a quick patch to respect `Retry-After` and to cap retries on auth failures.

support-eng: letting customer know workaround (pin + env flag). ETA for server shim + patched clients: ~2 hours. will update here when prod patch deploys.

tina: once PR merges, please add a short note in the changelog and a line in the SDK upgrade guide about header ordering and retry behavior. we should also add a regen CI check that verifies auth header invariants (unit test that asserts header canonicalization).

marco: agreed. action items: raj -> PR + changelog, tina -> review, lin -> hotfix guide for support, support-eng -> customer comms. follow-up at +4h.

support-eng: noted, customer escalated to priority. will attach logs to PR.

marco: thanks team — keep updates short. :thumbsup:
